name: arch
description: Review code for reuse, dependency health, architectural fit, accidental complexity, and evidence-backed architecture views.

interface.shortDescription: Review code and map architecture with evidence.
interface.longDescription: Evidence-first architectural oversight for finding duplicated behavior, stale or deprecated dependencies, boundary violations, brittle workarounds, unjustified complexity, and for rendering scoped repository-grounded architecture views.
defaultPrompt: Review this change and map the affected architecture when a diagram clarifies it.
Prefer repository reuse and the smallest language-idiomatic design; tie material diagram edges to repository evidence.
